title: Fix Plane Section Layout in Sketchpad Detail Panel
description: The plane section (Origin, X-Axis, Y-Axis) in the piece detail panel uses a broken layoutKind="property" expandable={false} with DetailInlineAxisStepper children, causing visual misalignment, squished fields, and inconsistency with the rest of the detail panel. Restructure to use standard TreeItem defaultOpen + TreeRow > Stepper showLabel pattern matching center, scale, and other fields.
summary:
Restructured plane section and center section in the piece detail panel to use the standard TreeItem + TreeRow > Stepper showLabel pattern, fixing visual alignment and consistency.

## Changes in compose/sketchpad/index.tsx

### Plane section (Origin, X-Axis, Y-Axis)
- Replaced TreeItem layoutKind="property" expandable={false} + DetailInlineAxisStepper with standard TreeItem defaultOpen={true} + TreeRow > Stepper showLabel
- Each axis coordinate (X, Y, Z) is now its own TreeRow with a labeled Stepper

### Center section
- Changed from layoutKind="property" to defaultOpen={true} for consistency

### Removed DetailInlineAxisStepper
- Deleted unused component

### Updated test assertions
- Center alignment test: queries nextElementSibling instead of tree-property-label/tree-property-content slots
- Plane spacing test: queries nextElementSibling instead of tree-section-content slot

All 105 unit tests pass.
